items.claim: Adopt the stationary impermeable linear friction boundary condition (sigma n)_tau=-beta u_tau, beta>=0, with SI units and no universality claim.
source_uses: Chen and Qian, arXiv:0901.0147v1, §§1–2, equations (1.3)–(1.4), (2.5), Proposition 2.1; their finite slip length zeta and density-normalized viscosity map to beta=eta/zeta.
items.argument_disposition: Adopted postulate; both current physical suppliers are Step-1 ready; no measured coefficient or universal law is claimed.

items.claim: Derive the pointwise forced momentum equation from the adopted material momentum balance for a smooth constant-density incompressible Newtonian material motion.
items.argument_disposition: Complete local argument: change variables along the material motion, differentiate with Jacobi’s formula, apply the divergence theorem to traction, then use inverse images of small balls and continuity to localize. The unforced equation in the incompressible definition is expressly not used; body force comes from the adopted material balance.

items.claim: Derive bounded-wall and periodic-channel mechanical power identities for the stated smooth incompressible Newtonian model; bounded stationary homogeneous uniqueness is conditional on the current S06 supplier.
items.argument_disposition: Kinetic work, both boundary identities and bounded stationary uniqueness are fully supported. The current S06 statement, complete integrating-factor Gronwall proof and Step-1 readiness record match the exact uniqueness clause.

items.claim: Differentiate the positive-density barotropic equations at a uniform rest state, rescale to the normalized periodic system, and derive global smooth tangent evolution, energy conservation and dispersion.
items.argument_disposition: Complete conditional deduction. The actual current positive-density barotropic definition and ready periodic mathematical theorem match; there is no finite-amplitude error claim.

items.claim: Verify exact no-slip Poiseuille and Couette channel profiles, their fluxes, vorticities and matching body/wall power with viscous dissipation.
items.argument_disposition: Complete direct substitution and integration; the current wall-power supplier and all of its required current prerequisites are ready.
